dataList.dlg: Here for some thread? All right, then tell me what you're here for—let's see what color your desires and longings have. If it's a shade I can admire, well... I might just let you have some.

The season's barely begun, and you're already making the most of it. With that much want to draw on, I'd say we can look forward to spinning some fine thread.
So, come on... let me hear it, won't you? Lucky for you, I've got all the time in the world to listen.

Think I'll take a little weight off the wheel... *groan* With the Voice of Fate gone quiet, no sense wearing myself down, spinning without a break... Ah, join me for a bite? This new Voice—the Crimson Voice—has deigned to speak to us. And He says when the urge to consume comes calling, we're to let it have its way.

Waiting 'til the last minute, aren't you? Coming to me for thread now, when the next season's about to roll in... *puff* ... Oh, I see. So this yearning of yours isn't some passing whim that just frays away with the change of the season—sure, I like that. All right, suppose I'll get wheeling then, huh?

Hmm... A radiant color, still steeped in sunlight. Back in the day, I'd have had a hard time letting thread like that go... But you know, things change. Nowadays, I find myself looking past the thread's beauty, instead admiring the hides I'll sew with it.

... Let's say you'll just be spinning your wheels if there's no dye to work with. Best you stop by the Dyehouse for a bit. You'll have to take a number and get in the queue for the popular stuff... Ah, though you could get through a fair bit quicker if you don't rub that fella in the Dyehouse the wrong way... Could. Hah, and if you're a smoker, make sure to let the cigarette wait its turn outside.

I've got... well, this for an arm, you see. Hard to do anything that needs a delicate touch when one side of you's built like this. But... see this? Attach a doodad here, another thingamajig there—and as far as useful goes... *puff* it can pull its weight, I suppose. Look, I can run the needle through this part and thread it with the other... And there you go. Usually takes at least three people to pull that off.

Get a good grip on that cocoon, wring it dry... and all kinds of desire will ooze and spill from it. Liquid desires that will draw out into a single fine thread... Twist it once, give it another turn... *puff* Hard not to reach for it when it's just there for the taking. Say, why don't we settle on a little deal? I take half for myself, and you buy the half that's left. Come on, it's a fair enough arrangement, isn't it? You get to leave with the thread you want instead of joining my spools yourself.

All that time at the wheel, and every last thread went to patch and cover someone else's back—because that was what the Voice of Fate wanted.
*puff* And I'm following wherever the Voice leads, same as ever. This time, the Crimson Voice says that the thread I spin's gonna warm my own back, and I live to obey His instructions. Oh, but that shouldn't mean I'm... feathering my own nest.
... Getting bored? Why don't you light one up, then? My Skein Nest here's a smoking area.
Right, our wants have crossed threads, eh? And there's only one way... to align them. One desire must be swallowed to make room for the other.
So, got some thread you want spun?
I like to work without hindrance. Guess I'll have to get rid of these myself.
Hmm... Did you bring the dye you need?
Bygone things of eld. That's all they are.
That's just the way it goes.
The thread's all tangled up...!
My yearning was simply more honest than yours. No dressing it up.
Couldn't find... a spool for it...
Well, I had nice material to spin from.
Thread spun under hindrance—that's what this is. You can't expect any beautiful colors.

With this... every last strand's been drawn. A bit less radiant after that business with those things of eld, but give it some decent hide to hold it together, and it'll serve nicely enough.
*puff* What was that? Well, can't argue with that. These days, fine thread's no longer the be-all end-all like it used to be for me.

Now that's... almost making me covet it in earnest. Spun clear as a gemstone, a vivid crimson with a shine to match. *puff* Have you got a spool for it? No? Th-that's, uh... fine. Make it into a nice and round tangle of yarn. Round, all right? That's the most stable shape.

No need to... make a big deal out of it. I suppose my yearning just didn't measure up. When one desire's greater, the other gets swallowed to make room. It's always been— ... Has it? My yearning... wasn't strong enough? Hundreds, thousands of seasons, each one layered into the next... and it still wasn't enough?!
